explication: FS25 Realistic Livestock is a Farming Simulator mod for individually tracking and managing livestock. The principal workflow is players opening the RL Menu to inspect, filter, trade, move, and automate herds; animal identity, genetics, health, breeding, and production provide the domain capabilities behind that management. The graph groups documented features by responsibility and uses source directories where the tree supports them. No source excerpts were supplied, so relationships are limited to those stated in the README; implementation-level call paths are not asserted.
